segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Pag may packed silica, may additional 65 to 90.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Okay, so they plan to scale up all of these utilities, Mr. President, both in terms of energy and water consumption.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Marami kasi nagtatanong kung talaga yung Bangot, O'Donnell, Abacan Rivers, kaya-kaya niyan,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: i-supply lahat ng water requirements ng packed silica sa hinaharap nating Super El Nino.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Okay, based on the feasibility studies of this joint venture, according to BCDA, kakayaanin naman daw po.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But definitely, now that we're taking this up here, I guess in the hearings, we will have to delve deeper into this to find out.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Sana magkaroon ng second hearing. Wala pa kasi yan. Tagal na eh.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Gusto kong malaman kung meron na talagang impact na pinag-aralan nationally.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Ang irrigation, ang NIA, ang National Water Resources Board, kung i-divert lahat ng tubig nitong ilog natin,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: anong mangyayari sa existing agricultural irrigation systems, downstream communities, all the existing and overarching water rights?

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Kasi alam naman natin, heavily populated itong area na ito, higit sa lahat, eto na yung rice basket ng buong Pilipinas.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Was that the Economic Affairs Committee? May I ask the help of Senate President Gatchalian, that hearing that we had on Pax Inca?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Yes, I think it was the...

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: I think Environment, the Committee on Environment.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, I'm sure, Mr. President, we can ask for a second hearing because things are moving.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Yeah, we actually created a committee of a whole.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Because the Pax Inca project is multidimensional.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: It has economic consequences, it has environmental consequences, it has legal consequences.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So, we created a committee of a whole.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, we will support, Mr. President, the convening of this committee of the whole at the proper time

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: so we can have transparency with regard to what it is exactly that we're talking about, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: So, I just looked at my notes.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: It appears that the proposed K-water and Manila...

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: The joint project involves 14.8 billion pesos with large infrastructure inputs.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Is any part of this projected capacity earmarked already for Pax Inca?

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: So, this joint project with K-water preceded Pax Inca.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: It's initially made for the needs of New Clark City.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: So, yung mahihingi ko na lamag, e garantiya mula sa BCDA na walang tahanang Pilipino na magkukulang ng tubig.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: At saka lahat ng magsasaka ay hindi mawawalaan ng akses sa kanilang irigasyon.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Pwede bang hingin ang pangako ninyo kasi marami pang nangangamba?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, yes, the answer is yes.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: But we've also been informed here that if the plans of New Clark City for water and electricity come to pass,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: there should be an excess even for the neighboring areas.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Of course, yan yung plano, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And I think the proper venue would be the Committee on the Whole to go into detail about all of these issues being raised also.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Yes, which is why we need to get that scheduled impeachment or budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: So, BCDA provides that guarantee, and I hope no Filipino taxpayer will be required to subsidize the water requirements of PacSilica,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: which should, instead of burdening us, help us develop our manufacturing capability.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And we are with you in a lot of these concerns.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And hopefully, Mr. President, the Senate can be the venue.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: For transparency and to really share with the people, ano ba talaga yung mga nakaplano dito, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: There was a recent survey result that came out that majority were not in favor of this initiative.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And clarity, I think, will help people understand better kung dapat ba itong masuporta o hindi.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: And we have asked, even from the first hearing, our friends from BCDA, and BOI, si Yusek Rodolfo,

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: To be very clear with ano ba yung mga next steps dito, ano ba yung papasukan natin, ano ba yung goals natin dito.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: Because until today, Mr. President, pabago-bago rin yung information, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: So, thank you very much to the gentle lady from Ilocos Norte.

segments.speaker: Senator Paolo Benigno "Bam" Aquino IV
segments.text: She asked me in all of my agencies today.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Thank you to the good sponsor.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And definitely, once we convene the committee of the whole, we will request the different agencies to give us full,

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: briefing, and the full details of the PacSilica project.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Robin, hindi ka na magtatanong na?

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: So, with that, Mr. President, I move that the budget of the Basis Conversion Development Authority be deemed submitted.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Hearing none, the budget of the Basis Conversion and Development Authority is hereby...

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Moving to the next budget, may we recognize,

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: may we move that the Department of Energy be taken up for debate and plenary.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: This is the last, but not the least, department, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: The last for tonight, or for this morning.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: May we recognize our distinguished colleague, Senator Pia Cayetano, to sponsor the measure.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: May we recognize Senator Pia Cayetano, the sponsor for the budget of the Department of Energy,

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: as well as the other energy-related organizations.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Um, once again, this may be the last but not the least. May we recognize to defend the budget of the Department of Energy, our colleague Senator Pia Cayetano.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: We recognize the gentle lady from Taguig City, Senator Pia Cayetano.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. President. Good morning, Mr. President. I am ready to sponsor the budget of the Department of Energy.

segments.text: I understand that we will be

segments.text: as I understand it. Thank you,

segments.text: and we thank you for no

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: beses po akong pumunta sa Bukidnon,

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: at pagpunta ko doon, dalawang beses rin

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: at maging ang turismo dahil marami

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Kawawa po ang ating mga kababayan

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: natin na nagbabayad naman ang tamang

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Sa totoo lamang po, willing naman po magbayad yung mga kababayan natin basta mabigyan lang po sila ng maayos na servisyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Pero basta, maayos na servisyo po ang iniexpect ng ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: I call on the concerned electric cooperatives, Davao Oriental Electric Cooperative, Doreco in Davao Oriental,

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: and First Bukidnon Electric Cooperative in Bukidnon to improve your services.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: I want to remind you that the grant of franchise is not a right but a mere privilege.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: At nananawagan rin po tayo sa Department of Energy.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Kaya nga po, tinawag po itong Departamento ng Energy.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Under Republic Act 7638, DOE is mainly responsible for energy policymaking, energy security, electricity supply,

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: consumer protection and monitoring, among others.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: At sa NEA naman, kayo rin po ang responsible sa pag-supervise at monitoring sa performance ng electric cooperatives.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Sabi nga nila, you cannot compel the NGCP dahil private naman po ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: But siguro naman, pwede nyo naman po silang pakiusapan.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: At ako po yung nakikiusap rin po sa inyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Sana po'y matutukan nyo ito at gawan ng paraan ang problema sa

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: outdated cables. Decades old na po itong mga ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Kaya kulang po ang daloy ng kuryente.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Yun po ang rason sa Davao Oriental.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Dahil malayo po ito, dulo po ito yung Davao Oriental.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: At taga doon rin po ako.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Sana po itutukan at kalampagin nyo rin po sana ang NGCP para matugunan ang pangangailangan sa mga area na ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: At monitor nyo rin po ang mga electric cooperatives.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Ako rin naman po, importante sa akin yung trabaho.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Ng ating mga kababayan, lalong-lalo na po yung mga mahirap nating kababayan na nagtatrabaho lang po at may natatanggap na sweldo mula sa electric cooperatives.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Huwag po silang mawalan ng trabaho.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Ang gusto lang po natin, magtulong-tulong tayo para magkaroon ng mas affordable at reliable na supply ng kuryente sa ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Hindi lang po sa Davao Oriental at sa Bukidnon, kundi pati na rin po sa buong bansa.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: And I'm sure alam po ng Department of Energy, yan po ang naging malaking problema po sa ngayon.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Importante po sa akin ang trabaho, pero pag may brownout naman po, apektado yung negosyo, apektado yung turismo, apektado rin po ang trabaho ng ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: So pakibalansin na lang po ang lahat at matugunan sana ito ng Department of Energy.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Kaya nga po tinawag kayo na Department of Energy.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Kung tutukan niyo po ang energy issue or problem sa ating bansa.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Yun lang po, Mr. President, Madam Sponsor, kasi wala na yata rito yung inyong NEA Administrator, parang anniversary nila, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: So umalis na po yata siya.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: So ayoko na lang pong tanongin yung kapwa ko, Senador, since nandito naman po itong mga officials.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Alang-alang lang po sa ating mga kababayan na apektado po dito sa problema sa brownout.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Mr. President. Magandang umaga.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Mr. President, since Bukidnon was mentioned, when it first happened, I intervened.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Nagpadala po ako ng sulat sa Fibeco kasi yung district area na yun is Fibeco.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: So nagpadala ako ng sulat. They gave a lengthy explanation.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Yun nga, there was an outing.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: But it was quick. I think it was only like 20 minutes or something.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Natimingan lang po na nagsispeech si Sen. Bong Go noon na brownout.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Dalawang beses. Sabi ko. Pero hindi kami nagpa-brownout.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Siguro kung sinamahan mo ako doon na majority floor leader, baka hindi po nagka-brownout.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Babantayan kanila na hindi magka-brownout doon.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Alam mo na, iba yung suspect ko na nagpa-brownout.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Wala naman siguro. Wala naman siguro nga ganun.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: So Mr. President, I know because of the latest of the hour, we just try to lighten the mood.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: But definitely we look into it.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: And I'm sure the Secretary to the NEA will also.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Yes. Just to respond, the Secretary has already spoken to Sen. Bong Go earlier

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: She will be sending a team to address this issue.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: I actually also asked the Electric Cooperative to write a formal letter.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: And then I submitted it to Sen. Bong Go.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: But I don't think he was satisfied with the answer.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Because he said, well of course in the letter there was an outage from the NGCP at the same time.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: There's also problems with yung punong kahoy, di ba?

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Trees, yung tumatama sa poste, sa mga linya.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: And they're clearing it out now.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: But I guess maybe a more comprehensive answer would suffice and satisfy our distinguished colleague.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Hindi lang naman po siguro ito sa Mindanao, sa Bukidnon and Dava Oriental itong problema nito.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: And I'm sure alam niyo po yung mga reklamong yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Christopher Lawrence T. Go
segments.text: Sana magkaroon na tayo ng brownout free dito sa ating bansa.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Thank you, Sen. Bong Go for the short.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Mr. President, we'd now like to recognize the distinguished colleague, Sen. Rizal Tiveros, to propound some questions.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Salamat po, Mr. President. At magandang umaga po sa good sponsor.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Originally po, meron akong halos isang dosenang paksa.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Pero in the interest of time, kakalahatiin ko na lang sa lima, tatlo para sa DOE at dalawa para sa ERC.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: And then, isasabit ko na lang, Mr. President, sa good sponsor yung ibang mga tanong ko para masagot ng department bago tayo dumako sa period of amendments.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Mahigit isandaang gasolinahan na ang nahuli ng DOE.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Yan ang nirereklamo ng mga motorista.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Pag price increase, ang pilis taasan.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Pero pag price decrease, ang bagal.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: So, in effect, napipwersang magbayad ng overpriced rates kada litro ang consumers.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: At kailangang mabawi rin ng mga motorista ang sobrang siningil sa kanila.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: So, may paraan po ba ang DOE para tulungan ang consumers, Mr. President?

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Kasi dapat mabawi nilang sobrang binayad nila.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: The response, Your Honor, of DOE is that they issue show-cause orders, and then if there is a finding and there's a violation, then they can mete out the penalty. As to some kind of refund or compensation, they're still studying how to go about that.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: All right. Salamat, good sponsor. May kailangan ba ang department sa budget natin para maipatupad ang mga ito?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: No, no. They just have to study how to go about it.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: All right. And ngayon din mismo, may big time na rollback sa presyo ng petrolyo. Paano titiyakin ang department na tama yung presyo sa gas stations nationwide?

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: At ano ang magiging parusa sa mga lumabag at nag-overcharge?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, according to DOE, under RA 8479 and E0110, DOE is undertaking implementation of the mandated weekly price adjustment and monthly price adjustments,

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: implementation of fuel subsidy discount programs. This is 12 pesos per liter on diesel of PUV.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: For a total of 1,000 pesos, 1,800 per week. Discount promos of the private oil companies and nationwide inspection to enforce the proper implementation of the DOE weekly mandated price adjustments.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Salamat po. May parusa ba kapag mayroon silang ma-identify na hindi sumunod sa rollback?

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: And again, sapat ba ang budget ng department para pagbantayan ito?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, of course, they go through the process.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Your Honor, they have a show-cause order, and then when there's a finding, they can impose a penalty and in the worst case scenario, they can cancel the permit.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: And tulad nung unang tanong, hindi na nila kailangan ng dagdag pang budget para gawin ang mga steps na ito?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Hindi na po. It's part of their mandate.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And they have the support of the DILG and then the LGUs.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Wala pa mga ELNINIO noon, nararanasan natin ang brownout.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Yellow alerts at red alerts lalo na sa Visayas at Mindanao.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Dapat po may nakalaan na sa 2027 budget ng DOE para masigurong tuloy-tuloy ang operasyon ng lalo na ating mga ospital at ating mga eskwelahan

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Magkano po ang inilaan natin para dito at ano yung mga kaakibat na contingency plans ng department?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, according to the Secretary, Your Honor, hospitals and schools are mandated to have their backup gensets available and they continue to monitor this.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And then there is also a NDRR MC Resolution No. 2 Series of 2026 that provides for the standards.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: We can give Her Honor a copy.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Ano yung item na nakalaan na sa budget para sa mga ito?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Okay. So, for example, for the hospitals and schools, it's in their specific budgets.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: At the same time, good sponsor, Mr. President, sa ganyang mga pagkakataon, mas lalong dapat isama sa pinupondohan natin ang solar at saka battery storage.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Sa mga public hospitals, public schools, actually, pati sa mga SUCs.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Tulad ng sinimula na ngayon sa UP Solarization Project.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: At especially kung madalas mag-brown out.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Nakwenta na rin ba natin kung magkanong kailangan para mais ako tuparan ito sa buong bansa?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, actually, yung binanggit ko na NDRR MC Resolution No. 2, 2026,

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: kasama dyan, solar PV with battery storage, ang preferred, ano talaga, source, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And then, yung funding source ng mga LGU would be coming from the local DRRM fund, national DRRM fund, ER-194 fund, climate finance, and other eligible funding sources.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Alright. So, hindi na po kailangan ng may dagdag pang items sa DOE budget separately.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: So, sa last on this particular topic, dun sa budget na meron tayo sa 2027, ilan ang kaya nating maseribisyohan in terms of the schools and hospitals?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, actually, as mentioned earlier, this is already in the budgets of the respective institutions.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, kung sa school, nasa school, hospital, nasa hospital. So, nandiyan na ho yun, they're supposed to budget for that already.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Alright. Then, bago nga yung huling paksakot sa DOE, one step back dun sa unang paksa, tungkol sa paanong bababawi ng consumer yung sobrang binayad nila,

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: meron din bang pinag-aaralan ng DOE na paraan ng, kung hindi diretsyong refund, pag natabi nung customer yung resibo nila,

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: pagbalik dun sa gasolinahan kung saan sobra palang binayad nila noon, may paraan ba na ma-offset yung susunod na babayaran nila?

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Masama yun. Masama yun, your honor, dun sa pinag-aaralan nila.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Noong Setiembre, sinabi ng DOE na target nila ang zero brownout sa Visayas at sa Mindanao ngayong papasok na Disyembre.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: na walang brownout at maliwanag ang Pasko ng mga pamilyang Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Makakapagsindi ba ng parol ang bawat pamilyang Pilipino ngayong Pasko?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, her honor is correct that that is the objective.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, what they can do, what is within their power is to make sure that everything that is required to happen is in place.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: They're doing all that, making sure that the power plants are functioning up to par, etc., etc.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, it goes without saying that if in place lahat ito, then the chances of being successful in what we want to achieve, which is zero brownout, will happen.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Natansya ba nila? Ano yung percentage na chance na ma-achieve nga yung objective na ito by next month sa Visayas at Mindanao?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Let's try to understand the reason for the brownouts.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Mangyayari yan kung mag-fail yung power plants.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Kaya, ang gagawin nila, address nila yun.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Ensure that these power plants can perform.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, reserves is already the backup, di ba?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: I think that's part of the, what's the term there?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Yung proper maintenance and to assure steady supply is may reserve ka.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: It's one thing to say na wala yan, tas wala kang reserve.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: I mean, it won't happen, wala kang reserve.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, that's already being responsible by ensuring that there's additional reserves and incoming generating capacity, intergrid transfers.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: This is all intended to prevent the supply-related interruptions.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: So, I believe, Mr. President, what the good sponsor is saying, that the department is doing all that.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Lalo na dahil yung department ang nag-set ng target.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Wala pong nag-impose sa kanila na wala ng brownouts sa Visayas at Mindanao by December.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: So, can they promise na makakasindi ng parolang bawat pamilyang Pilipino?

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Or may percentage ba that they think they will be achieving the self-imposed target by next month?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, I think I've answered that.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Your Honor, to the best of DOE's ability to respond.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, they can't give us an estimate?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Kasi, Your Honor, what they can do nga, as I said, and as I will repeat,

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: is they are doing everything to ensure that itong power plants are functioning and then may reserve.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, if they do that, then the chances of having brownouts is very minimal.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: They would have given me a percentage.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: I've heard her Honor's question, but I guess they're not able to really give that.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: But they want to give that assurance as best as they can.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Well, I guess I'll have to accept that answer from the department.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Disappointing lang kasi ang ganda sana nung target na naset.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: And I'm sure umasay yung mga kababayan natin sa Visayas at Mindanao by next month.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: And for the record, Mr. President, good sponsor, tayo dito sa Senado, when we set targets,

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: and then we ask each other sa mga komite natin, halimbawa, ano na yung progress report,

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: more or less, we are able to put a number to our own target.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: So, I was expecting more from the department.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: And maybe by the time of the period of amendments, they can come up with a better answer for us

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: at sa mga kababayan natin, lalo na who are hoping for a brighter Christmas

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: than they have experienced in the past months or this whole year, actually.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Magkano po yung inilaan natin sa 2027 budget para tuluyan na nga matugunan ang problema sa brownout sa Visayas at Mindanao?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, um, Your Honor, these are private-sector commitments, no? And so what DOE is doing is they're keeping abreast of what's happening, keeping track of the commitments, particularly on battery and barges, kasi diyan ho nanggagaling yung reserve. Kaya nga, like I said,

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: There's a supply, but the backup there is to have the reserve.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, they're not literally the ones in charge of those reserves, but they're on top of it,

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: ensuring that ito nga, yung batteries and the barges are in place.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: And magkano pong inilaan, Mr. President, para sa barges at sa batteries?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: It's a private endeavor, as I said, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: But is the DOE not able to disclose to us?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Would you like a list of those contracts?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Again, we'll ask them to provide, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Moving on to my couple of topics para sa ERC.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Ang pinakamahalagang tungkulin ng ERC ay pagpapababa sa presyo ng kuryente

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: at pagtatanggol sa kapakanan ng mga consumer.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Sa tulong ng budget na binigay sa commission,

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: magkano ang aasahan o target ng ahensya na pagbabasa singil sa consumer

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: ng mga distribution utilities next year, Mr. President?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Can I just ask the question to be repeated?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Because even if you pass me the answer, I want to hear the question myself.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Magkano ang aasahan o target ng ERC

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: singil sa consumer ng mga distribution utilities next year.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, to be clear, Your Honor, the mandate of ERC is to ensure that the investments in the generation and transmission are bare fruit.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Because if this is accomplished, then it will naturally happen that the prices will go down.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Paso supply and demand lang po yun, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Kung nandyan yung capacity to provide, then there will be enough supply and the prices will come down at a lower.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Pag kulang ang supply, edi nagmamahal.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, that is the mandate of ERC, to ensure that this is in place.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Unfortunately, Mr. President, good sponsor, yun na nga yung pangako sa ilalim ng EPIRA at doon na nga dinerive yung ganyang mandate ng ERC.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: And although there have been numerous investments in the last quarter century at maraming private sector stakeholders ay kumita,

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: hindi pa natin na-achieve yung least cost price para sa mga consumers.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: So, hindi purely nag-ooperate yung law of supply and demand dito.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: So, given that hindi pa optimal.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Na situation, meron din bang tansya ang ERC kung by how much bababa ang singil,

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: pagsingil sa customers ng mga distribution utilities sa 2027.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: The first thing that they are doing to address this concern, which is yung mataas na presyo,

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: at yung goal naman is very clear na bumaba sana ang presyo, is addressing the backlog.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: That I know, kasi in the years that I was chairman of the...

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: of the Committee on Energy, that really has been an ongoing concern.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, I remember when the last hearing I had, that's really something that was highlighted by ERC.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And then second is yung rate reset.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Now, as to her honor's specific question, magkano.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: It's difficult to answer because as I said, supply and demand.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: But going to the price are beyond the control of ERC.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And as her honor knows, the peso, like hindi naman...

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: I don't think anyone had expected na ganito kasama yung exchange rate natin ngayon.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: I think no one can say that.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And then yung price ng fuel natin talagang mataas.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, if let's say all of these things are in place na na-address yung backlog,

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: pero God forbid na sobrang tumangit yung ating peso rate,

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: then yung pinapredict nila magbabago din.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: I think her honor can understand that kasi there's a lot of...

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Parang commodities yan eh na nagbabago talaga yung price.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: But I think we are one in hoping that with at least the two major issues,

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: efforts of ERC, which is addressing the backlog and the rate reset,

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: it's going in the right direction.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: I'm beginning to see a pattern here, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Good sponsor sa sagot ng mga agencies natin na hindi makapagbigay ni ng target

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Target na siya mismo nag-set in the case of DOE nung Setyembre

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: or mandate nila sa ilalim ng batas in the case of ERC.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: We could talk a lot also about that rate reset, kung paano mas maayos na ginagawa yan ng ERC.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: But ERC is not as powerless as they say they are.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: May mga kapangyarihan din ng ERC kahit sa ilalim ng EPIRA

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: to exercise more assertively and proactively alang-alang sa mga consumers.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Can they only tell us yung mga external factors na di umano,

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Given their powers under the EPIRA,

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: are they not even going to try to set a target for next year?

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Maybe, Mr. President, ERC should also study or explore

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: capping, fuel, and forex cost pass-through to consumers.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Magagawa ba natin ito through regulations?

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: O kailangan pa ba intayin yung amendments sa EPIRA para gawin ito?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Your Honor, according to ERC, of the total electricity bill,

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: what they can regulate is 25% of that.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So in the case of the generation charges,

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: if her Honor is suggesting or asking that this be capped,

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: then for ERC, it would be very difficult for them

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: On that side, on the generation side,

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: main ano niya is so much more expensive because of factors beyond their control like the war, the depreciation rate, that is not beyond their control.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So kung itatali sila ng ERC, baka huwalang pumayag kasi nga kahit sila, it's beyond their control, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Well, nabanggit Mr. President ng Good Sponsor yung generation charges.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Isa yun sa mga tanong na isasubmit ko na lang sa Good Sponsor para sa ERC dahil kung yung system loss charge ay 5 to 10 percent sa bill na pinapason sa consumers,

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: yung generation charges ang pinakamalaki, constituting around 60 percent.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: And naka-fold in pa doon yung cost of fuel na hindi pa fully dinidisclose ng lahat.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: At ang tanong kong isasubmit ko dyan sa Good Sponsor ay tungkol sa pag-review ng mga power supply agreements.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Huling paksa ko para sa ERC, and ito, pangatlong beses ko na pong itatanong sa ERC, yung pag-audit na mga fuel pass-through ng generation companies nga po.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Isa sa mga bagay na tinatanong din ang

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: May resulta na ba ang review ng ERC?

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Kasi sabi po ng Commission dati na ayaw itong i-disclose ng mga generation companies.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: I can read to you, Your Honor, what was given to me.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Based on the audit procedure approved by the Commission, 10 DUs and generating companies pairs were identified.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: To be part of the first batch to be subjected to fuel audit, they were selected based on the

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: A, size of consumer exposure, this is the DU's total energy sales, and B, magnitude of the fuel cost increase, the blended generation rate billed during the period.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: By assigning equal weight to these criteria, the prioritization methodology ensures that the audit captures the DU-GENCO pairs

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: that not only exhibit significant fuel cost-related increases, but also have the,

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: greatest potential impact on consumers, consistent with the objectives of the approved audit procedure.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: The audit team has completed evaluating the documents submitted by one DU-GENCO pair, which was included in the initial batch.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: An exit conference will be scheduled with the said pair before the audit report is finalized.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Evaluation of the other GENCO-DU pairs, their submission is ongoing.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Apat na pairs pa ang pending.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Mga kailan daw nila matatapos good sponsor yung audit na ito?

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: So, may timetable po ba sila para makumpleto itong unang batch na review?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: By first quarter of next year, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: May kakailanganin pa ba sa budget ng ERC sa susunod na taon para,

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: para makumpleto ang fuel audit na ito?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: No, they can handle it, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: And kapag nakumpleto na nila ito, first quarter next year,

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: pwede po bang magkaroon ng kopya ang kongreso ng mga resultang ito?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Yes, ang sagot po nila is yes.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: So, sa pagwawakas ko, Mr. President, good sponsor,

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: ulitin ko na lang yung sana naman pagdating ng period of amendments,

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Kahit hindi 100%, basta some concrete and realistic commitment

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: na sa mga pamilya at households Pilipino,

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: lalo na sa Visayas at Mindanao,

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: ilang porsyento sa kanila ay may kasiguruhan na

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: kung gusto nila magsindi ng parol ngayong Pasko,

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Tulad ng unang tinarget ng department noong September.

segments.speaker: Senator Risa Hontiveros
segments.text: Salamat, good sponsor at sa Dio.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Next will be Senator Aimee Marcos.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: At hindi naman akong mag-interpolate as such,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: kundi sasabihin lamang na sa ating chairwoman at sa ating sekretary,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: pati na rin sa ating president,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: this isn't the first time we've had an oil price shock.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: We went through it in 1974 and 1979,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: and without declaring that I'm the oldest person in the room

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: na maari pa siguro natin ulitin ngayon,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: tayo ang pinakamataas sa Southeast Asia,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: 15 to 16 pesos sa Metro Manila area,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Ang bigat noon, it's so high,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: in all of ASEAN, we're the highest.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: So clearly, our neighbors are doing things that we had done before,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: So maraming nagtatanong kung open ang DOE sa iba't-ibang suggestion.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Dahil hindi po namin nakikita sa budget ang ganito.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Unang-una, yung fixing the outdated power supply agreements,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: they're still tied to very old, expensive contracts sa Ilocos Norte.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Nakatali rin kami dyan sa mga legacy-legacy contracts na yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Wala bang posibilidad na isuspenso o magdeklarasyon ang DOE?

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Nateka muna, pwede naman siguro huminahon muna dito

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: sa mga legacy contracts at renegotiation.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Anong opinion ni Secretary at ni Chair dyan?

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: They're still tied to all these old, expensive contracts reliant on fossil fuels

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: na para sa amin, sana naging renewable na dahil marami namang kaming renewable sa Ilocos.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Pero we're stuck with those contracts, 10 years.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Tumatangong si Secretary, baka pwede naman isuspend,

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Yes, they are willing to look into it, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Yes, and then another thing is,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: pag nagkaroon ng gulo na sa WESEM,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: is it possible that we enforce competitive bidding?

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Yung competitive selection process for the brand new contracts that we will embark upon?

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: And then remove the automatic fuel pass-through clauses

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: that insulate the power generators from global price hikes?

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: It could significantly lower baseline rates.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Kasi magiging competitive bidding na yan eh.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: And then yung automatic fuel pass-through.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Is that something we can consider?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: They're already implementing and looking into this competitive selection, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Kasi I don't see it in the line items of the budgets.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Pero siguro nandyan sa operation costs naman ninyo, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: As long as there's a commitment to that.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Kasama na sa policy, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: And sana tignan ninyo nga yung mga legacy contracts

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: that are burdening so many electric cooperatives,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: And the other aspect that we could embark upon,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: I don't know, this is a suggestion from an old energy hand,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: is to clear the transmission and grid bottlenecks.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Under the EPIRA, transmission capacity has simply failed to keep pace

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Alam natin yan, yung ibang transmission na dekada 70 pa yan,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: So we have to accelerate the grid upgrades

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: May existing power plants that are only operating

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: and the secretary, I've heard you talk about this,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: they're only at 50% efficiency and capacity.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: So hindi ko alam kung luma ba yan

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: or kung ano ba yung problema nila.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Pero yun na naman, wala na naman sa budget,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: kailan ba maa-upgrade yung aging infrastructure

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: so that we can minimize the unplanned outages

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: and stabilize supply, prevent sudden price hikes

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: I know it's expensive, yung mga power plant efficiency, di ba?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Your Honor, the response is ERC has already been approving

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: the submitted proposals for CAPEX of NGCP.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: So we have that to look forward to.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Yes, and then in addition, doon naman sa dagdag niyong question,

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: For talking to NGCP, to allow government...

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: To allow government to directly fund or...

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Okay, so for government to undertake the transmission.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Yes, inasmuch as they haven't done anything about it,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: they haven't modernized, they haven't invested,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: I think government simply needs to take over.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: I have also heard the Secretary talk about establishing our own refineries.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: We're stuck with one privately owned refinery.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Ano ba ang posisyon ng DOE?

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Kasi wala rin sa budget ninyo, plano or FS sa refinery.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Kasi I heard the Secretary, parang naganahan kami, nabuhayan kami nun eh.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: I mean, obviously, that's a very, very big investment.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Your Honor, PNOC currently, and they do have a budget for it,

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: the first step is the storage facility.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And then, the second step is more storage.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And then, they are now in...

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: They're in talks for refineries, Mr. Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Actually, that's the other thing that I was going to inquire about.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Expanding the battery energy storage systems.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Across the country, 7,000 islands to stabilize intermittent wind and solar

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: and cut reliance on expensive diesel peaker plants.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Hinahanap ko rin kasi sa budget ninyo yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Kasi eto yung mga structural bottlenecks, quite apart from basic household conservation, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Where we can bring down the cost.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, your honor, they have policies on best for the storage.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Pero kailangan natin bilhin yung battery.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: The requirement pa nga is that for a project, 20% of it has battery storage.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Which brings me to another topic, and that's to remove the red tape on rooftop and distributed solar.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Kasi ang dami-daming red tape, ang dami-daming pirma, wala na si Mig Subiri, isa yung nagre-reklamo lagi.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: How do we streamline permitting and net metering?

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: The long approval times, o ayan, kasali na LGU dyan, hindi naman lahat kasalanan DOE.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: And the distribution utilities, they simply discourage...

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: home owners and businesses from installing solar.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Nakakapagod ikot-ikotin lahat ng opisyal at magpapirma ng sagkatutak na papel.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: And even with the new legislative push, yung zero export solar bills natin,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: the proposal to cut down on renewable hardware costs,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: ang dami-daming proposal, pero kapag ganong kabagal yung red tape,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: paano ba itulak yung mga LGU?

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Dapat ba i-penalize yan, or yung mga utilities, kailangan ba may sanction para kumilos?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: On that last point, na ang dami-dami, matagal, so ARTA is now involved.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Because that really is the goal, to simplify it.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, to distinguish, when there is no net metering involved,

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: then wala nang mga iba-iba pang permits, they just have to inform the DOE.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Kasi marami talaga napuput off dahil ang hirap-hirap.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: The other thing, of course, is that we are always being told that there's millions in green financing.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: But to unlock state-backed financing sa pag-ibig, sa SSS, sa GSIS,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: for low-interest microloans, for residential solar and battery setups,

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Nag-aawas na sila sa sweldo eh.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Tapos magmuha na tayo dyan sa mga pag-ibig, yung mga yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Kasi may pera na yan eh.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Pero what we want is they promote it.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, there is like a GSIS and is it also?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: But they are meeting along with the executive secretary, these agencies, to really promote it.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: They're not offering it as an option.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: That there should be low interest, micro loans.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Pwede kang mag-solar para sa business mo, para sa bahay mo.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And they're working also with the provincial governments to, so that on the local, on the ground.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: And then makakapagbigay pa ng trabaho yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Dapat hilain rin yung TESDA at yung mga trade and training institutions.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Para silang magturo ng scaling up local installation labor.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: You will generate lots of jobs just putting up all those solar panels and so on.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Dapat mag-training rin yung TESDA para sabay-sabay.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: And then you will successfully unlock all that government financing.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, they're currently doing trainings, as her honor mentioned, and accreditations.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: She agrees with everything that the, the, our honorable senator from Ilocos said.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: And that's to unblock all the stalled renewable energy projects.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: The transition from imported coal and gas is moving much slower than planned.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: I looked at the budget for RE and it's business as usual.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: We know we're in panic mode.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: We have to push and enforce the auction timelines.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Ang liwanag ng timeline but less than 20% conform with those timelines.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: So, the government's first two green energy auctions have been completed but less than 20%.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: 80% delay, suspension, right of way, permitting.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Anong mga may face, one and two?

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, uh, your honor, yung Green Energy Auction 1 and 2

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So they've corrected this and for 3 and 4, they're succeeding.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Excited kasi kami dyan. Akala namin talagang yun na yung sagot.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Kaso 20% lang ang successful eh. Kaya the hurdles really are structural and need to be overcome.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Finally, ito is not entirely a DOE. But at the end of the day, kayo rin ang sasagot ng pambayad.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: And that is modernizing the cold chain and industrial efficiency.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: We've been obsessing about headline inflation and of course they encompass by and large food costs as well as the rise in energy prices.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: So overhauling agricultural logistics is very clearly part of that.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: And they all rely, all these cold storage facilities of VA, of DAR, they rely very heavily on expensive grid electronics.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Electricity and crude oil, diesel, which is now even more expensive than gasoline.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: So scaling up energy efficient, climate smart cold chain hubs like those piloted under the National Cold Storage Industry Roadmap.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Na palagay ko DOE is also part of that planning.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Would reduce all that energy waste and stabilize the peak grid demand.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Ayan eh. At pwede naman siguro i-adjust.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Your Honor, there is a fuel transition plan.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: To really lower the dependence on fossil fuel.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: And they're working closely with DA to...

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Right now the solar irrigation is being distributed by both DA and NIA.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: What is the best situation with the cold storage?

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Kasi yung logistics chain very heavily dependent and very, very gasoline and diesel consuming.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: If there's a way for us to transition that quickly, we will be able to bring both food costs as well as energy costs down in one go.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, Your Honor, they have discussions with NIA to put together a green energy auction for their water assets.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Oh, that's great for the cold storage and other logistics facilities.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Yes, that solar irrigation is in place. It's the post-harvest now that's costing so much.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, sa DA naman, they're talking to them so that yung cold storage nila would be using renewable energy.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, they're discussing that with them to help them make that transition.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Thank you so much for being open to all these suggestions.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: As I said, this isn't our first rodeo.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: And many of these structural roadblocks were present even in the 70s and can be overwhelmed by action on the part of the Department of Energy.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: And of course, we in the legislature.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Of course, we in the legislature will be very happy to support and legislate as necessary.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: At inaasahan ko na bababa ang presyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Yes. Salamat for all your interventions, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Just to close, I just have a slide to show.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Susundan ko lang yung mga interpellation ni Sen. Risa dahil windy kami.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Susundang ko yung kanyang question on pricing.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And since we finished ASEAN, tinignan ko yung ASEAN electricity rates, ngayon tayo na mayroong pinakamahal na electricity rates sa ASEAN.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: At itong slide na ito, ang nagpapahirap sa Pilipinas, ito rin nagpapahirap sa mga Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: At it's no coincidence also na in ASEAN, tayo rin ang...

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Because mataas ang presyo ng kuryente natin.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: It's very hard to invite FDIs kung ganito ang presyo ng kuryente natin.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Kahit na anong roadshow natin sa buong mundo, kahit anong incentives ang ibibigay natin kung mataas ang presyo ng kuryente natin,

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: walang papasok at papasok sa ating bansa.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So, this is a challenge to the DOE.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Tama ho si Sen. Risa, trabaho to ng ERC.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: At next year with your new budget, we urge you to focus on how to bring down electricity rates.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: In fact, tama po yung sinabi ni Sen. Aimee, maraming over-contracting, maraming legacy PSAs, mabagal tayo mag-reset ang WAC natin,

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Hindi lang tayo determinadong ibaba ang presyo ng kuryente.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So, ito po yung hamon namin sa ERC.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Dati malaki ang tiwala ko sa ERC pero para ngayon, nawawalan na ako ng tiwala na bababa ang presyo ng kuryente natin dahil meron tayong effective na regulator.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So, with that, we have a new budget. We have a new year.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Ang challenge namin sa ERC and also to the DOE is to lower down our electricity rates.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: Just to give a quick response to the Senate President.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: They have a 10-year energy plan that they would like to show the Senate President where they're changing the energy mix.

segments.speaker: Senator Pia S. Cayetano
segments.text: So, they'll show you as soon as it's ready.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: May I just add also, Mr. President, if I may?

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: On the questions raised by our colleagues, also one of Senator Ivey on the art, on the ease of doing business,

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: I must say that the DOE has improved immensely.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: They have an EVO system now.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: All the dates are accounted for.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: They have a certain number of days where they actually release the results.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: I have to salute the members of the DOE.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Secretary, you're doing a good job on that.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: On the energy mix, the reason why medyo mahal po tayo ngayon, alam po natin may nag-bug down ng mga plants yung Visayas.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Hindi na yung kasalanan ng DOE yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Although, talagang alam ko sinisigawan na ni Secretary yan.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: And the ERC has already given like show-cause orders to these guys.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: And I think they really worked well.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: They have a reasonable time to get their plants up and running.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: So I think the prices in the Visayas and Mindanao area will stabilize in the next month or so.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: So that would stabilize also the prices and bring them down.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Alam naman ni Secretary ang kailangan gawin.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: We just have to put more projects out.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: No service contracts na hindi gumagalaw.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Dapat ipalabas at itayo nila itong mga service contracts na ito.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: But I'm sure we'll have so many players, so much competition that the prices will go down.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: So I think patience is needed.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: It's really hard at this point in time.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: But lalo na El Niño na iyon, napakahirap.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: For agriculture, for yung masaya lang sa El Niño, solar power providers.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Pero yung mga hydro power providers, mga hirap na hirap.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: But then again, I have to say, there are some good points.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: And we can highlight these good points that they've been doing.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: I'd like to congratulate the DOE.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: And let's give a chance also to the ERC.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: They don't look for problems and stick to the problems.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: They're problem solvers and that's what we need right now.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: But we get the order of the Senate President.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: We have to bring down the rates.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Really have to concentrate on that.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: But we'll support them with what they need.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: So with that, Mr. President, I move that the budget of the Department of Energy

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: under the Office of the Secretary, the National Electrification Administration,

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: the National Power Corporation, National Electrification Administration,

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: the Philippine National Oil Company, na ulit-ulit yata,

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Energy Regulatory Commission, and all other attached agencies be deemed submitted.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Hearing none, the budget of the Department of Energy, the Energy Regulatory Commission,

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: and the other aforementioned energy agencies is hereby deemed submitted.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Thank you very much, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: May I ask before we suspend?

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: We'll just suspend immediately, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: I move that we suspend session until 2 o'clock.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: I will suspend the budget first.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: I move that we suspend the budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: And I'd like to also move that we suspend session until 2 o'clock.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: So ladies and gentlemen, please tell your principals that we will start at 2 p.m. tomorrow afternoon.

segments.speaker: Senator Juan Miguel "Migz" F. Zubiri
segments.text: Just a time check, Mr. President.

segments.speaker: Senate President Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Hearing none, the session is suspended until 2 o'clock in the afternoon today, Wednesday, November 25, 2026.
